property_summary: For any caller who pays exactly TICKET_AMOUNT to play, the reference contract always increases pot by msg.value (i.e., pot increases by TICKET_AMOUNT) after the call completes; the mutant that adds only (TICKET_AMOUNT - FEE_AMOUNT) causes pot to be smaller for some valid plays, so pot(reference) != pot(mutant) for some input.
change_summary: Changed pot update to add only (TICKET_AMOUNT - FEE_AMOUNT) instead of msg.value, altering pot after play.
